name: okrm-design
description: A method for taking a graphic or interface design from zero to one and making it: position, question, key point, framework with a readymade from the brief, object before layout, one strange decision that follows from the content; then the same chain carried into type (serif or sans, which one, why), scale, structure, colour, image and sequence, each decision with its reason, rendered as pages or a spec.

interface.displayName: OK-RM Design · 有意义的秩序
interface.shortDescription: From zero to one, through to the page: every visual decision says where it came from.
interface.longDescription: The deliverable is the design itself — a cover, a spread, a poster, a page, an interface — with a derivation document beside it. Upstream: positioning, three questions, the key point and its opposite, a performative framework whose readymade is taken from the brief's own objects, the object and its economy decided before any layout, and one decision a conventional designer would reject that follows from the content. Downstream, the same chain is carried into form: which typeface and why (the readymade's own type, who is speaking, ubiquitous languages first), two poles of scale, structure that follows the readymade, one flat colour as material, image placement, sequence — each as 'decision | because | the conventional move'. Thirty-four case paths, deviation operators, measured starting values, an order-sheet generator and checker, and acceptance gates on the path, the derivation and the work. Distilled from a London studio's published interviews, publishing catalogue and work; contains none of its artwork and reproduces none of its layouts.
defaultPrompt: Use $okrm-design to take this brief from zero to one and make it: upstream first, then the derivation table (type, scale, structure, colour, image, sequence, each with its reason), then render the pages.
用 $okrm-design 从零开始做这个项目并做出来：先写上游（定位、三问、关键点、框架、物件）和一条怪决定，再推导字体、尺度、结构、颜色、图像、序列，每行写「因为」，最后渲染页面。
Use $okrm-design to explain, from the brief, why this project should be set in a serif or a sans and which one.
